description: This file defines the IAsyncBatchProducer<T> interface within the Orleans.Streams namespace. The interface generalizes IAsyncObserver to allow production and handling of batches of items, primarily used by item producers in a streaming context.

classes.name: IAsyncBatchProducer<T>
classes.description: An interface extending IAsyncObserver<T> to support passing batches of items asynchronously along with an optional stream sequence token.

methods.name: OnNextBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously passes a batch of items to the consumer and returns a Task that completes when the batch has been accepted.
